images.alt: A waterfall among rocks with the printed poem A Life Poured Out.
images.rights_note: The issue masthead states “Some images © 2001-2002 www.arttoday.com” but does not identify individual assets; no asset-specific credit or licence is stated. The sole RGB JPEG xref 158 includes the poem title, all poem text, the word “Adapted”, and any image toning baked into its pixels. No clean underlying waterfall object, masks, separate text or recoverable base layers exist. A crop removing all typography would leave only a narrow, unhelpful fragment; the complete source raster is therefore retained as the documented unavoidable-overlay exception. The extracted JPEG had one trailing newline byte after EOI; it was re-encoded as standards-normalized baseline RGB JPEG at the original 505 × 504 pixel dimensions with nonzero 72 dpi density. Separate outer cover gradient xref 238, masthead and mailing panel are omitted.

html:
Beloved, let us live for others, living for others is of God
Everyone who lives for others is born of God and knoweth God
He that does not live for others, knoweth not God
For God lives for others

Beloved, this is how God lived for others
God sent His only begotten Son into the world
To be the propitiation for our sins
This is the true definition of love

Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought to live for others
If we live for others, God dwelleth in us
And His love is perfected in us
By this we are assured that God dwells in us

Beloved, whosoever shall confess to others
That the Father sent the Son to be the Savior
God dwells in him, and he dwells in God continually
God is love

Adapted
